 Save Share Comments IND vs PAK, U19 Asia Cup Final: India beat Pakistan by one wicket in thrilling last-ball finish to clinch title
 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 14, 2026, 19:14:10 IST SUMMARY India U19 produced a remarkable comeback to defeat Pakistan by one wicket in a last-ball thriller and clinch their record-extending ninth U19 Asia Cup title. Chasing 338, India were in trouble at 251/7 before Manal Chauhan (47) and Mohit Ulva (49* off 26 balls) revived the chase with a crucial partnership. Ulva held his nerve in the final over, smashing a boundary off the last ball to take India to 339/9 and seal a memorable victory. Earlier, Pakistan posted 337/9, powered by Usman Khan's 107, Abdul Qadir's 80 and captain Farhan Yousaf's 63. Kavya Patel claimed four wickets for India, while Chigurupati Venkata picked up three.
